title: Elucidating the multiple roles of hydration for accurate protein-ligand binding prediction via deep learning.
summary: Simulation-informed analysis identified a recurrent first-shell hydration pattern contributing to protein-ligand scoring in the studied complexes. The computational result does not prove a universal binding mechanism or experimental improvement across ligand systems.
ai_technology: A deep-learning model combined protein-ligand structural representations with hydration information to analyze contributions of water to binding-score prediction.
organization: Department of Medicinal Chemistry and Molecular Pharmacology, Purdue University, West Lafayette, USA
